name: rollout-stable
prompt: Users see the newCheckout feature switch on and off between page loads. Percentage rollouts must be stable per user: in the feature-flag code, decide with the project's existing string hash helper (find it; don't write a new hash) and enable a flag for a user when hash(`${flagName}:${userId}`) % 100 is less than the flag's rollout percentage. 0 % means never and 100 % means always. Don't use randomness.
